findings.description: `check` used to return True when the report was within policy. It now returns a list of problem messages, which is empty when the report is compliant. `if check(report, rates):` is therefore true only when violations exist. Reports that break policy (over the limit or missing receipts) are auto-approved, and compliant reports are sent to a manager as NEEDS_REVIEW.
findings.suggestion: Invert the condition: `if not check(report, rates): report.status = Status.APPROVED else: report.status = Status.NEEDS_REVIEW`.
findings.title: decide() treats the list of violations as a pass flag, so approval is inverted
